about_the_game:
You shouldn’t have clicked.

Now you’re caught in their web of madness.

Among the Strangers is a first-person cyber-horror game focused on the fears of cyber security, where an unknown group is watching you, hunting you, and whispering truths no one should know. The deeper you go, the clearer it becomes: this isn’t random. You were chosen to follow this trail. 

Story:

You wake up in a prison cell, unsure how you got there. The door opens automatically. A faint vibration draws your attention — your phone. You pick it up, its flashlight cutting through the darkness. The warehouse around you is abandoned, its corridors twisted with shadows and flickering monitors.

A voice comes through your phone, calling for help and warning you to run — someone is coming for you. Suddenly, you are ambushed by a twisted, masked figure, muttering about your judgment day.

Features:

  • Cyber-horror atmosphere – Investigate unknown, abandoned environments where technology and darkness create constant unease.

  • Survive with your smartphone – Your phone is more than a tool: use it as a flashlight, map, or even bait to escape the unknown.

  • Cyber traps and tricks – Detect and overcome deceptive systems and hidden traps designed to mislead or eliminate you.

  • Cyber puzzles and mind games – Decipher encrypted challenges and interactive digital games that test your wit and security instincts.

  • Hunters who play first – Intelligent stalkers track your every move, testing and tormenting you before you can escape.

Please note: Among the Strangers is currently in development. Features, visuals, and gameplay elements described here may change as the game evolves.
